whyUs.title: Try a small example
whyUs.text: Read the code, press Run, and see what happens. Change one thing and try it again.

whyUs.title: Learn one step at a time
whyUs.text: Start with a simple idea. Use the lesson list to move to the next step when you are ready.

whyUs.title: Practise and try again
whyUs.text: Answer questions and check your work. Read the reason for each answer. Mistakes help you learn.

whyUs.title: Find your starting point
whyUs.text: New to coding? Open Start here. Make a tiny web page, then learn HTML, CSS and JavaScript in order.

whyUs.title: No account needed
whyUs.text: Open a lesson and begin. Your progress and saved lessons stay in this browser on this device.

whyUs.title: Keep your place
whyUs.text: Mark a lesson as completed when you finish. Open My learning to see what you have done.

faq.question: Is CodeMaster Academy free?
faq.answer: Yes. You can read lessons, try exercises and take quizzes for free. You do not need to sign up or log in.

faq.question: Where should I start if I have never coded?
faq.answer: Open Start here to try your first web page. Then learn HTML for page parts, CSS for colours and JavaScript for actions. Take one lesson at a time.

faq.question: What comes with each tutorial?
faq.answer: Every tutorial has lessons, worked examples, practice questions, a quiz and a word reference. Read a lesson, try a small task, then check your answer. You can go back and try again.

faq.question: Can I try code on this site?
faq.answer: Yes. Press Run to try HTML, CSS, JavaScript or SQL in your browser. For other languages, you can read and copy the code. Those need a separate tool to run.

faq.question: Where is my learning progress saved?
faq.answer: Your progress is saved in this browser on this device. It does not move to other devices. Clearing browser data removes it. Learning settings lets you save a copy or clear your progress.

faq.question: What should I do if I find a mistake?
faq.answer: Open the contact page and make a note. Include the lesson name, its web address and what seems wrong. Do not include passwords or private details.

playgroundPromo.title: Play with code in your browser
playgroundPromo.text: Pick a small example, change the code, and press Run. Look at the result. Try changing a word or a colour. You can reset the example and start again.
